/* QuickSight fd25fcf9-5b50-47a8-8853-c84a39f3759e */
SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency

			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

		from

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, node_name as pbor_node_name
			, "level" as split_level
			, time_weighted_return_rc as time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_lc as time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_rc as pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_lc as pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_qtd_rc as pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), cmb as (
	select * from scd_perf
	union all
	select * from perf
), cmb_clean as (
	select
		cmb.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case
			when period = '1D' then '1. 1-Day'
			when period = 'MTD' then '2. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '3. QTD'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '5. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '6. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		cmb
	where
		value is not null
		and business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		and not ( pbor_node_name in ( 'Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' ) and metric_type = 'Return' )
)
select * from cmb_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_income_daily"

SELECT    
        tr.business_date AS RPT_DTE,
        substr(TRIM(to_char(tr.trade_date, 'yyyymmdd') ||':'|| tr.instrument_name ||':'|| tr.trade_id ||':'|| tr.current_contract_id),1,75) AS TRDDT_INSTR_MXID_BBGID,     
        substr(COALESCE(tr.trading_portfolio_code,' '),1,15) AS PFOLIO,    
        substr(COALESCE(tr.instrument_sub_type,' '),1,30) AS DSC_TYPE,    
        substr(COALESCE(tr.instrument_name,' '),1,35) AS INSTRUM,   
        substr(COALESCE(tr.underlying_instrument_name,' '),1,35) AS INSTRUM_UND, 		
        substr(COALESCE(tr.trade_status,' '),1,10) AS TRN_STATUS,    
        COALESCE(tr.current_contract_id ,'0') AS CONTRACT,
        tr.trade_date   AS TRN_DTE,    
        substr(COALESCE(tr.deal_type,' '),1,1) AS B_S,    
        substr(COALESCE(st.underlying_current_price_currency ,' '),1,3) AS PL_CURR,    
        COALESCE(st.quantity,0) AS QUANTITY,    
        COALESCE(tr.instrument_lot_size,0) AS SEC_LOT,    
        COALESCE(tr.trade_price,0) AS INTL_PRICE,    
        COALESCE(tr.current_price ,0) AS MKT_SPOT, 
        substr(COALESCE(tr.instrument_family_name_source,' '),1,5) AS FAMILY,    
        substr(COALESCE(tr.instrument_group_name_source,' '),1,5) AS TRN_GROUP,    
        substr(COALESCE(st.instrument_type_name_source ,' '),1,5) AS TYPOLOGY,    
        COALESCE(tr.instrument_strike_price,0) AS MP_TP_STRIKE,    
		COALESCE(CASE
        WHEN tr.instrument_Sub_Type = 'Commodity Option on Future' AND tr.deal_type = 'Buy' THEN (st.quantity)
        WHEN tr.instrument_Sub_Type  = 'Commodity Option on Future' AND tr.deal_type <> 'Buy' AND (st.quantity) >= 0 THEN ( - 1 * (st.quantity) )
        WHEN tr.instrument_Sub_Type  = 'Commodity Option on Future' AND tr.deal_type <> 'Buy' AND (st.quantity) < 0 THEN (st.quantity)
        WHEN tr.instrument_Sub_Type  = 'Equity Listed Option' THEN (st.quantity) * (tr.instrument_lot_size) * (tr.instrument_strike_price)
        WHEN tr.instrument_Sub_Type  = 'Interest Rate Future Option' THEN (st.quantity) * (tr.instrument_lot_size)
        ELSE NULL   END ,0) AS NOMINAL,    
        COALESCE(st.quantity ,0) AS CUR_NOMINAL,
        COALESCE(tr.broker_name,' ') AS BROKER,    
        COALESCE(tr.past_cash_flows_proceeds,0) AS PL_CSNFCP,    
        COALESCE(tr.future_cash_flows ,0) AS PL_FPNFCP,    
        COALESCE(st.market_value,0) AS PL_MVNFCP,    
        COALESCE(tr.brokerage_fee_amount,0) AS BROKER_FEE,
        COALESCE(tr.delta,0) AS OPTION_DELTA,   
        substr(COALESCE(tr.custody_account_code,' '),1,20) AS SST_ACCT,
        ' ' AS SEC_GROUP,
        ' ' AS SEC_TYPE,
        substr(COALESCE(tr.instrument_option_type, ' '),1,10) AS OPTION_TYPE,
       ' ' as OPTION_TICKER,
        COALESCE(tr.underlying_current_price,0) AS INDEX_SPOT,
        COALESCE(COALESCE(round((tr.DELTA)/(st.quantity)/(tr.instrument_lot_size),8) * 100, (tr.delta_per)),0)   AS OPTION_DELTA_ERA,
       -999 AS GID,
       ' ' AS TICKER,
        0  AS UNDL_FUTURE_PRICE,
        ' '  AS UNDL_FUTURE_PRICE_CURR,
        COALESCE(st.id_instrument_alternate,' ') AS ID_BB_UNIQUE, 
        ' '  AS BASE_TICKER,
		tr.id_instrument
FROM
    trades_deals.listed_options_trades tr
    INNER JOIN trades_deals.listed_options_positions st ON  tr.business_date = st.business_date
                                                         AND tr.run_description = st.run_description 
                                                         AND tr.trading_portfolio_code = st.trading_portfolio_code
                                                         AND  tr.id_instrument = st.id_instrument
WHERE
        length(COALESCE(TRIM(tr.id_instrument), ' ')) <= 20
    AND tr.business_date  = date '2025-06-16'
    AND st.instrument_Sub_Type =  'Equity Listed Option'
    AND tr.TRADE_STATUS != 'DEAD' 
    AND tr.run_description = 'EOD'

			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 17
		AND hour between 12 and 13
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-17 12:18:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 17
		AND hour between 12 and 13
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-17 12:06:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* QuickSight d7a3e3fc-fd07-4180-b08e-ce026556d8fd */
SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, node_name as pbor_node_name
			, "level" as split_level
			, time_weighted_return_rc as time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_lc as time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_rc as pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_lc as pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_qtd_rc as pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc

	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency

			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )

	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

		from

		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )

	cross join unnest (

		array[

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'

	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

	select

		, case

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency

			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc

					and scd.split_level = 1

				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (

	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency'

			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency

			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )

	/* DATA PULLED:

	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'

			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency

			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'

		, case

			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'

			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_rc as pnl_reporting_currency

			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'

			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )

		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-17 18:21:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY

		date_trunc('minute', datetime)

		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

SELECT *
        FROM (
		    SELECT
		        currencyCode,
			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_usd,
					date - LAG(date, 3) OVER(
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as data_diff
				FROM (
						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,
								erc.currency AS currencyCode,
								erc.exchange_rate AS currencyToCadRate,
								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag
						FROM cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad erc
								LEFT JOIN cppib_market_exchange_rate erd
								ON erc.data_date = erd.data_date
								AND erc.vendor = erd.vendor
								AND erc.currency = erd.currency

/* cppi::be78af6c65cc470b5590cb5e5527a37e071b53b2339d00aa037adb6537bfa6dc */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 17
		AND hour between 19 and 20
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-17 19:16:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

	    (select distinct pfc.business_date, to_currency_code as TO_CRNCY, mid_value as MID_VAL, (case when inverse_quoted_flag = 'Y' THEN 1 else 0 end) AS inv_quoted_flg 
        from market.cppib_rates  mcr 
		join reference.pfc_dates pfc on pfc.business_date = mcr.business_date
        where from_currency_code ='USD' and rate_type = 'SPOT' and  source_code = 'WM Company'
        union all 
		select business_date, 'USD' as TO_CRNCY, 1 as MID_VAL,0 as inv_quoted_flg from reference.pfc_dates      
      )	 ),
 T1_T2_Dates AS
(select TO_DATE('2025-06-16','yyyy-mm-dd') as T_1_Date,
  max(cast(business_date as date)) as T_2_Date
  from holdings.scd_holdings_main where cast (business_date as date) < TO_DATE('2025-06-16','yyyy-mm-dd') 
  )
SELECT  BUS_DTE,
        coalesce(MPFC1_CDE,'') as MPFC1_CDE,
        coalesce(MPFC2_CDE,'') as MPFC2_CDE,
        coalesce(MPORT_CDE,'') as MPORT_CDE,
        coalesce(instr_typ_nme,'') as instr_typ_nme,
        coalesce(sec_typ_nme,'') as sec_typ_nme,
        coalesce(sec_no,'')  as sec_no,
        coalesce(sec_nme,'') as sec_nme,
        coalesce(id_cppibsec,0) as id_cppibsec,
        coalesce(id_bb_ticker,'') as id_bb_ticker,
        coalesce(id_isin,'') as id_isin,
        coalesce(ID_BB_COMPANY,'0') as ID_BB_COMPANY,
		leg_no,
        coalesce(holding_level,'') as holding_level,
        coalesce(src_system_nme,'') as src_system_nme,
        coalesce(quoted_crncy,'') as quoted_crncy,
		coalesce(id_cusip,'') as id_cusip,
        cast(coalesce(T_1_BAL_NOMINAL,0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS T_1_BAL_NOMINAL,
        cast(coalesce(T_2_BAL_NOMINAL,0.0)as decimal(22,8)) AS T_2_BAL_NOMINAL,        
        cast(coalesce(T_1_LT_MKTVAL,0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS T_1_LT_MKTVAL,
        cast(coalesce(T_2_LT_MKTVAL,0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS T_2_LT_MKTVAL,
        cast(coalesce(T_1_CLEAN_PRC_QC,0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS T_1_CLEAN_PRC_QC,
        cast(coalesce(T_2_CLEAN_PRC_QC,0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS T_2_CLEAN_PRC_QC,
        cast(coalesce(T_1_CLEAN_PRC_UC,0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS T_1_CLEAN_PRC_UC, 
        cast(coalesce(T_2_CLEAN_PRC_UC,0.0)as decimal(22,8)) AS T_2_CLEAN_PRC_UC,
        cast(coalesce(T_1_FX_RTE_QC_PC,0.0)as decimal(22,8)) AS T_1_FX_RTE_QC_PC,
        cast(coalesce(T_2_FX_RTE_QC_PC,0.0)as decimal(22,8)) AS T_2_FX_RTE_QC_PC,
        cast(coalesce(T_1_FX_RTE_UC_QC,0.0) as decimal(22,8))AS T_1_FX_RTE_UC_QC,
        cast(coalesce(T_2_FX_RTE_UC_QC,0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS T_2_FX_RTE_UC_QC,
        cast(coalesce(CASE WHEN T_1_BAL_NOMINAL IS NULL AND T_2_BAL_NOMINAL IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(T_1_BAL_NOMINAL,0) - coalesce(T_2_BAL_NOMINAL,0)) END, 0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS BAL_NOMINAL_VARIANCE ,        
        cast(coalesce(CASE WHEN T_1_LT_MKTVAL IS NULL AND T_2_LT_MKTVAL IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(T_1_LT_MKTVAL,0) - coalesce(T_2_LT_MKTVAL,0)) END, 0) as decimal(22,8)) AS LT_MKTVAL_VARIANCE ,
        cast(coalesce(CASE WHEN T_1_CLEAN_PRC_QC IS NULL AND T_2_CLEAN_PRC_QC IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(T_1_CLEAN_PRC_QC,0) - coalesce(T_2_CLEAN_PRC_QC,0)) END, 0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS CLEAN_PRC_QC_VARIANCE ,
        cast(coalesce(CASE WHEN T_1_CLEAN_PRC_UC IS NULL AND T_2_CLEAN_PRC_UC IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(T_1_CLEAN_PRC_UC,0) - coalesce(T_2_CLEAN_PRC_UC,0)) END, 0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS CLEAN_PRC_UC_VARIANCE ,
        cast(coalesce(CASE WHEN T_1_FX_RTE_QC_PC IS NULL AND T_2_FX_RTE_QC_PC IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(T_1_FX_RTE_QC_PC,0) - coalesce(T_2_FX_RTE_QC_PC,0)) END, 0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS FX_RTE_QC_PC_VARIANCE ,
        cast(coalesce(CASE WHEN T_1_FX_RTE_UC_QC IS NULL AND T_2_FX_RTE_UC_QC IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(T_1_FX_RTE_UC_QC,0) - coalesce(T_2_FX_RTE_UC_QC,0)) END, 0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS FX_RTE_UC_QC_VARIANCE 
        FROM (          
              SELECT MAX(bus_dte) BUS_DTE,              
                     mpfc1_cde,
                     mpfc2_cde,
                     mport_cde,
                     instr_typ_nme,
                     sec_typ_nme,
                     sec_no,
                     sec_nme,
                     id_cppibsec,
                     id_bb_ticker,
                     id_isin, 
                     id_cusip, 
                     ID_BB_COMPANY,
                     leg_no,
                     holding_level,
                     src_system_nme,
                     quoted_crncy,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_1_Date THEN xyz.balance_nominal ELSE 0 END) T_1_BAL_NOMINAL,                     
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_2_Date THEN xyz.balance_nominal ELSE 0 END) T_2_BAL_NOMINAL,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_1_Date THEN xyz.total_market_value_pc ELSE 0 END) T_1_LT_MKTVAL,                     
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_2_Date THEN xyz.total_market_value_pc ELSE 0 END) T_2_LT_MKTVAL,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_1_Date THEN (xyz.total_market_value_qc/xyz.balance_nominal) ELSE 0 END) T_1_CLEAN_PRC_QC,                     
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_2_Date THEN (xyz.total_market_value_qc/xyz.balance_nominal)  ELSE 0 END) T_2_CLEAN_PRC_QC,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_1_Date THEN (xyz.total_market_value_qc/xyz.balance_nominal)* (1/FXRATE_UC_QC) ELSE 0 END) T_1_CLEAN_PRC_UC,                     
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_2_Date THEN (xyz.total_market_value_qc/xyz.balance_nominal)* (1/FXRATE_UC_QC) ELSE 0 END) T_2_CLEAN_PRC_UC ,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_1_Date THEN xyz.FXRATE_QC_PC ELSE 0 END) T_1_FX_RTE_QC_PC,                     
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_2_Date THEN xyz.FXRATE_QC_PC ELSE 0 END) T_2_FX_RTE_QC_PC,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_1_Date THEN xyz.FXRATE_UC_QC ELSE 0 END) T_1_FX_RTE_UC_QC,                     
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_2_Date THEN xyz.FXRATE_UC_QC ELSE 0 END) T_2_FX_RTE_UC_QC                    
				from	
					(SELECT mhl.business_date as bus_dte,              
                     eh.investment_department_responsibility_code as mpfc1_cde,
                     eh.investment_department_sub_group_responsibility_code as mpfc2_cde,
                     eh.model_portfolio_id as mport_cde,
                     eh.abor_instrument_type as instr_typ_nme,
                     eh.security_security_type_name as sec_typ_nme,
                     eh.abor_security_number as sec_no,
                     escundl.esm_security_name as sec_nme,
                     escundl.cppib_sec_id as id_cppibsec,
                     escundl.esm_ticker as id_bb_ticker,
                     escundl.isin as id_isin, 
                     escundl.cusip as id_cusip, 
                     escundl.bloomberg_id AS ID_BB_COMPANY,
                     mhl.leg_no,
                     mhl.holding_level,
                     escundl.esm_source_id as src_system_nme,
                     mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code as quoted_crncy,
                     CASE WHEN mhl.balance_nominal = 0 THEN NULL ELSE mhl.balance_nominal END as balance_nominal,                     
                     mhl.total_market_value_pc,                     
                     mhl.total_market_value_qc,
					 Round(CASE WHEN mhl.underlying_currency_code = mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code THEN 1.00 
								WHEN FXRATE_Quoted.inv_quoted_flg=1 AND FXRATE_Underlying.inv_quoted_flg=0 THEN (FXRATE_Underlying.MID_VAL * FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL) 
								WHEN FXRATE_Quoted.inv_quoted_flg=0 AND FXRATE_Underlying.inv_quoted_flg=1 THEN 1/(FXRATE_Underlying.MID_VAL * FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL) 
								WHEN FXRATE_Quoted.inv_quoted_flg=1 AND FXRATE_Underlying.inv_quoted_flg=1 THEN (FXRATE_Underlying.MID_VAL / FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL) 
								ELSE (FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL / FXRATE_Underlying.MID_VAL  )
							END,8) as FXRATE_UC_QC, 
					 Round(CASE  WHEN 'CAD' = mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code THEN 1.00 
								WHEN FXRATE_Quoted.inv_quoted_flg=1 AND FXRATE_Portfolio.inv_quoted_flg=0 THEN (FXRATE_Portfolio.MID_VAL * FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL ) 
								WHEN FXRATE_Quoted.inv_quoted_flg=0 AND FXRATE_Portfolio.inv_quoted_flg=1 THEN 1/ (FXRATE_Portfolio.MID_VAL * FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL  ) 
								WHEN FXRATE_Quoted.inv_quoted_flg=1 AND FXRATE_Portfolio.inv_quoted_flg=1 THEN (FXRATE_Portfolio.MID_VAL / FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL  ) 
								ELSE (FXRATE_Portfolio.MID_VAL / FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL )
							END,8) as FXRATE_QC_PC,
                     T1_T2_Dates.T_1_Date,
                     T1_T2_Dates.T_2_Date					 
					from holdings.enterprise_holding eh
                    join holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough_extended mhl on  mhl.business_Date  = cast(eh.business_Date as date) and eh.scd_holding_key_id = cast(mhl.parent_holding_key as varchar)
              /*     INNER JOIN (
                            select * from (          
                            SELECT row_number() over (order by business_date desc) as row_num,business_date FROM T1_T2_Dates             
                            WHERE business_date <= TO_DATE('2025-06-16','yyyy-mm-dd') 
                                                     ) where row_num <= 2 
                    ) AX ON mhl.business_date = AX.business_date */
					join T1_T2_Dates T1_T2_Dates ON (cast(eh.business_date as date) = T1_T2_Dates.T_1_Date OR cast(eh.business_date as date) = T1_T2_Dates.T_2_Date)
                    LEFT JOIN asset.enterprise_security escundl ON mhl.enterprise_security_id = escundl.enterprise_security_id and mhl.business_date = escundl.business_date --child
					left outer join FXRATE FXRATE_Quoted ON  FXRATE_Quoted.TO_CRNCY =  mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code and FXRATE_Quoted.business_date = mhl.business_date
				    left outer join FXRATE FXRATE_Underlying ON  FXRATE_Underlying.TO_CRNCY =  mhl.underlying_currency_code and FXRATE_Underlying.business_date = mhl.business_date   
                    left outer join FXRATE FXRATE_Portfolio ON  FXRATE_Portfolio.TO_CRNCY =  'CAD'  and FXRATE_Portfolio.business_date = mhl.business_date  
                    WHERE 1=1
                 and eh.portfolio_calculation_id = 'RISK METRICS_DAILY'
                and eh.portfolio_group_id = 'CPPIB GROUP'
                     AND ( 
							(upper(trim(eh.abor_security_type_id)) in ('FUT_BOND','CDS','TRSEQIC','TRSFIIC')    
								AND upper(mhl.holding_level) = 'LOOK THROUGH')
							OR
							((upper(trim(eh.abor_security_type_id))) in ('OP_OC_CR','IRS_IR','OP_OC_SW_P','OP_OC_SW_W')
								and upper(mhl.holding_level) = 'TOP LEVEL')
						) 
                    AND ( (  upper(trim(mhl.parent_security_type_name)) not LIKE '%INDEX%' 
                                  and mhl.leg_no < 2 
                                  AND upper(trim(eh.abor_security_type_id)) in ('FUT_BOND','TRSEQIC','TRSFIIC'))
                        OR ( mhl.leg_no = 2 AND upper(trim(eh.abor_security_type_id)) = 'CDS') )
					) xyz
                    GROUP BY 
					 mpfc1_cde,
                     mpfc2_cde,
                     mport_cde,
                     instr_typ_nme,
                     sec_typ_nme,
                     sec_no,
                     sec_nme,
                     id_cppibsec,
                     id_bb_ticker,
                     id_isin, 
                     id_cusip, 
                     ID_BB_COMPANY,
                     leg_no,
                     holding_level,
                     src_system_nme,
                     quoted_crncy
            )              
        WHERE
        1 = 1
        AND 
        (
          (T_1_BAL_NOMINAL IS NOT NULL OR T_2_BAL_NOMINAL IS NOT NULL) OR          
          (T_1_LT_MKTVAL IS NOT NULL OR T_2_LT_MKTVAL IS NOT NULL) OR
          (T_1_CLEAN_PRC_QC IS NOT NULL OR T_2_CLEAN_PRC_QC IS NOT NULL) OR
          (T_1_CLEAN_PRC_UC IS NOT NULL OR T_2_CLEAN_PRC_UC IS NOT NULL) OR
		  (T_1_FX_RTE_QC_PC IS NOT NULL OR T_2_FX_RTE_QC_PC IS NOT NULL) OR
          (T_1_FX_RTE_UC_QC IS NOT NULL OR T_2_FX_RTE_UC_QC IS NOT NULL))

WITH FXRATE AS
    (select distinct * from
	    (select distinct pfc.business_date, to_currency_code as TO_CRNCY, mid_value as MID_VAL, (case when inverse_quoted_flag = 'Y' THEN 1 else 0 end) AS inv_quoted_flg 
        from market.cppib_rates  mcr 
		join reference.pfc_dates pfc on pfc.business_date = mcr.business_date
        where from_currency_code ='USD' and rate_type = 'SPOT' and  source_code = 'WM Company'
        union all 
		select business_date, 'USD' as TO_CRNCY, 1 as MID_VAL,0 as inv_quoted_flg from reference.pfc_dates      
      )	 ),
 T1_T2_Dates AS
(select TO_DATE('2025-06-16','yyyy-mm-dd') as T_1_Date,
  max(cast(business_date as date)) as T_2_Date
  from holdings.scd_holdings_main where cast (business_date as date) < TO_DATE('2025-06-16','yyyy-mm-dd') 
  )
SELECT  BUS_DTE,
        coalesce(MPFC1_CDE,'') as MPFC1_CDE,
        coalesce(MPFC2_CDE,'') as MPFC2_CDE,
        coalesce(MPORT_CDE,'') as MPORT_CDE,
        coalesce(instr_typ_nme,'') as instr_typ_nme,
        coalesce(sec_typ_nme,'') as sec_typ_nme,
        coalesce(sec_no,'')  as sec_no,
        coalesce(sec_nme,'') as sec_nme,
        coalesce(id_cppibsec,0) as id_cppibsec,
        coalesce(id_bb_ticker,'') as id_bb_ticker,
        coalesce(id_isin,'') as id_isin,
        coalesce(ID_BB_COMPANY,'0') as ID_BB_COMPANY,
		leg_no,
        coalesce(holding_level,'') as holding_level,
        coalesce(src_system_nme,'') as src_system_nme,
        coalesce(quoted_crncy,'') as quoted_crncy,
		coalesce(id_cusip,'') as id_cusip,
        cast(coalesce(T_1_BAL_NOMINAL,0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS T_1_BAL_NOMINAL,
        cast(coalesce(T_2_BAL_NOMINAL,0.0)as decimal(22,8)) AS T_2_BAL_NOMINAL,        
        cast(coalesce(T_1_LT_MKTVAL,0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS T_1_LT_MKTVAL,
        cast(coalesce(T_2_LT_MKTVAL,0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS T_2_LT_MKTVAL,
        cast(coalesce(T_1_CLEAN_PRC_QC,0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS T_1_CLEAN_PRC_QC,
        cast(coalesce(T_2_CLEAN_PRC_QC,0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS T_2_CLEAN_PRC_QC,
        cast(coalesce(T_1_CLEAN_PRC_UC,0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS T_1_CLEAN_PRC_UC, 
        cast(coalesce(T_2_CLEAN_PRC_UC,0.0)as decimal(22,8)) AS T_2_CLEAN_PRC_UC,
        cast(coalesce(T_1_FX_RTE_QC_PC,0.0)as decimal(22,8)) AS T_1_FX_RTE_QC_PC,
        cast(coalesce(T_2_FX_RTE_QC_PC,0.0)as decimal(22,8)) AS T_2_FX_RTE_QC_PC,
        cast(coalesce(T_1_FX_RTE_UC_QC,0.0) as decimal(22,8))AS T_1_FX_RTE_UC_QC,
        cast(coalesce(T_2_FX_RTE_UC_QC,0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS T_2_FX_RTE_UC_QC,
        cast(coalesce(CASE WHEN T_1_BAL_NOMINAL IS NULL AND T_2_BAL_NOMINAL IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(T_1_BAL_NOMINAL,0) - coalesce(T_2_BAL_NOMINAL,0)) END, 0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS BAL_NOMINAL_VARIANCE ,        
        cast(coalesce(CASE WHEN T_1_LT_MKTVAL IS NULL AND T_2_LT_MKTVAL IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(T_1_LT_MKTVAL,0) - coalesce(T_2_LT_MKTVAL,0)) END, 0) as decimal(22,8)) AS LT_MKTVAL_VARIANCE ,
        cast(coalesce(CASE WHEN T_1_CLEAN_PRC_QC IS NULL AND T_2_CLEAN_PRC_QC IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(T_1_CLEAN_PRC_QC,0) - coalesce(T_2_CLEAN_PRC_QC,0)) END, 0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS CLEAN_PRC_QC_VARIANCE ,
        cast(coalesce(CASE WHEN T_1_CLEAN_PRC_UC IS NULL AND T_2_CLEAN_PRC_UC IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(T_1_CLEAN_PRC_UC,0) - coalesce(T_2_CLEAN_PRC_UC,0)) END, 0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS CLEAN_PRC_UC_VARIANCE ,
        cast(coalesce(CASE WHEN T_1_FX_RTE_QC_PC IS NULL AND T_2_FX_RTE_QC_PC IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(T_1_FX_RTE_QC_PC,0) - coalesce(T_2_FX_RTE_QC_PC,0)) END, 0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS FX_RTE_QC_PC_VARIANCE ,
        cast(coalesce(CASE WHEN T_1_FX_RTE_UC_QC IS NULL AND T_2_FX_RTE_UC_QC IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(T_1_FX_RTE_UC_QC,0) - coalesce(T_2_FX_RTE_UC_QC,0)) END, 0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS FX_RTE_UC_QC_VARIANCE

              SELECT MAX(bus_dte) BUS_DTE,              
                     mpfc1_cde,
                     mpfc2_cde,
                     mport_cde,
                     instr_typ_nme,
                     sec_typ_nme,
                     sec_no,
                     sec_nme,
                     id_cppibsec,
                     id_bb_ticker,
                     id_isin, 
                     id_cusip, 
                     ID_BB_COMPANY,
                     leg_no,
                     holding_level,
                     src_system_nme,
                     quoted_crncy,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_1_Date THEN xyz.balance_nominal ELSE 0 END) T_1_BAL_NOMINAL,                     
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_2_Date THEN xyz.balance_nominal ELSE 0 END) T_2_BAL_NOMINAL,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_1_Date THEN xyz.total_market_value_pc ELSE 0 END) T_1_LT_MKTVAL,                     
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_2_Date THEN xyz.total_market_value_pc ELSE 0 END) T_2_LT_MKTVAL,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_1_Date THEN (xyz.total_market_value_qc/xyz.balance_nominal) ELSE 0 END) T_1_CLEAN_PRC_QC,                     
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_2_Date THEN (xyz.total_market_value_qc/xyz.balance_nominal)  ELSE 0 END) T_2_CLEAN_PRC_QC,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_1_Date THEN (xyz.total_market_value_qc/xyz.balance_nominal)* (1/FXRATE_UC_QC) ELSE 0 END) T_1_CLEAN_PRC_UC,                     
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_2_Date THEN (xyz.total_market_value_qc/xyz.balance_nominal)* (1/FXRATE_UC_QC) ELSE 0 END) T_2_CLEAN_PRC_UC ,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_1_Date THEN xyz.FXRATE_QC_PC ELSE 0 END) T_1_FX_RTE_QC_PC,                     
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_2_Date THEN xyz.FXRATE_QC_PC ELSE 0 END) T_2_FX_RTE_QC_PC,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_1_Date THEN xyz.FXRATE_UC_QC ELSE 0 END) T_1_FX_RTE_UC_QC,                     
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_2_Date THEN xyz.FXRATE_UC_QC ELSE 0 END) T_2_FX_RTE_UC_QC

					(SELECT mhl.business_date as bus_dte,              
                     eh.investment_department_responsibility_code as mpfc1_cde,
                     eh.investment_department_sub_group_responsibility_code as mpfc2_cde,
                     eh.model_portfolio_id as mport_cde,

                     eh.security_security_type_name as sec_typ_nme,
                     eh.abor_security_number as sec_no,

                     escundl.esm_ticker as id_bb_ticker,
                     escundl.isin as id_isin,

                     escundl.bloomberg_id AS ID_BB_COMPANY,

                     mhl.holding_level,
                     escundl.esm_source_id as src_system_nme,

								WHEN FXRATE_Quoted.inv_quoted_flg=1 AND FXRATE_Underlying.inv_quoted_flg=0 THEN (FXRATE_Underlying.MID_VAL * FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL)
